description: This file defines the TableRenderInfo class, which provides rendering metadata and relationships for table objects within the MigraDoc document rendering library.

classes.name: TableRenderInfo
classes.description: A class representing rendering information specific to table objects within the document layout process.

methods.name: FormatInfo
methods.description: Getter and internal setter for the format information related to the table's rendering details, such as row visibility.

methods.name: DocumentObject
methods.description: Getter and internal setter for the document object associated with the rendering info, specifically a Table in this context.
